# paddle_adjustment (Action)

Creates a Paddle adjustment (refund, credit, or a chargeback-related record) against a transaction — see https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/adjustments/create-adjustment. Paddle has no idempotency-key support, and adjustments have no update/delete operation once created, so this action lists existing adjustments for the same `transaction_id` and treats a match on `action`+`reason` (and `type`, if set) as already-done rather than creating a second one — best-effort correlation, not a guarantee (docs/guardrails/money-moving-actions-no-blanket-retry.md). **This moves real money or changes a real customer's balance in a live (non-sandbox) environment.** See this provider's README for operational guidance (a separate, tightly-scoped API key; not running this under `-auto-approve` without review) before using it in an automated pipeline.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) One of `credit`, `refund`, `chargeback`, `chargeback_reverse`, `chargeback_warning`, `chargeback_warning_reverse`, `credit_reverse` — the full enum Paddle's API accepts.
- `reason` (String) Why this adjustment is being made. Also used, best-effort, to detect whether an equivalent adjustment already exists — see this action's own top-level description.
- `transaction_id` (String) The transaction being adjusted (`txn_...`). Must be completed (auto-collected), or billed/past_due (manually-collected).

### Optional

- `items` (Attributes List) Line items to adjust. Required by Paddle's API when `type` is `partial` — not cross-field-validated here, Paddle's own API error is authoritative (same default this provider already applies to `paddle_discount`'s `discount_group_id`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `tax_mode` (String) `internal` or `external`. Only meaningful for partial adjustments.
- `type` (String) `full` or `partial`. Paddle defaults to `partial` server-side if omitted — left unset here rather than defaulted client-side, since actions have no state to reconcile a client-side default against.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Required:

- `item_id` (String) The transaction line item being adjusted (`txnitm_...`).
- `type` (String) `full`, `partial`, `tax`, or `proration`.

Optional:

- `amount` (String) Required by Paddle's API when this item's `type` is `partial`; omit otherwise.
